---
name: Missed duplicate or false alarm
about: Winnow missed a real duplicate or leak, or flagged photos that are different
title: ""
labels: ""
---

**Which was it?** Missed a real pair / flagged a pair that is different

**The pair.** File names only. Please do not attach photos you don't have the rights to share.

**What Winnow reported.** Which check flagged it (hash, embedding, keypoints), the keypoint count, and the pair's report entry if you have it.

**What you expected, and why.** For example "same photo, cropped" or "two different cards that share a printed frame".

**Your data.** Roughly how many photos, what kind (product shots, video frames, scans, ...), and whether a fixed camera took them.
